mapper.select: SELECT * FROM conversation_job_retry WHERE requested_by=#{actor} AND idempotency_key=#{key}
SELECT * FROM conversation_job_retry WHERE message_id=#{message} AND generation=#{generation}

SELECT r.* FROM conversation_job_retry r JOIN conversation_message m ON m.id=r.message_id JOIN conversation c ON c.id=m.conversation_id WHERE c.student_id=#{student} AND r.status IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING')
SELECT * FROM conversation_job_retry WHERE status='QUEUED' AND accepted_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP-interval '130 seconds' ORDER BY accepted_at,id LIMIT 20
SELECT * FROM conversation_job_retry WHERE status IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING') AND COALESCE(started_at,accepted_at) <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP-interval '130 seconds' ORDER BY accepted_at,id LIMIT 20
mapper.update: UPDATE conversation_job_retry SET status='RUNNING',started_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND status='QUEUED' AND accepted_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP-interval '130 seconds'
UPDATE conversation_job_retry SET status=#{status},finished_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND status IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING')
UPDATE job_execution SET status=#{status},error_code=#{code},finished_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND status='RUNNING'
